subject.title: fix(google-meet): bound Calendar v3 events.list request deadline

question: Should Google Meet Calendar v3 `events.list` lookups fail closed after a hardcoded 30s default request deadline?
rationale: The patch uses an existing guarded-fetch timeout seam and fixes a real hang class, but it changes shipped external Google API wait behavior for existing users.

options.title: Accept 30s Calendar Default
options.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the deadline bounds a real hang class without adding config surface.

options.title: Inherit Existing Operation Timeout
options.body: Revise the Calendar helper to derive from an existing Google Meet operation timeout while preserving a bounded fallback.

options.title: Pause For Shared Policy
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers define one timeout policy across Calendar, Meet, Drive, and OAuth calls.

recommendation.title: Accept 30s Calendar Default
recommendation.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the deadline bounds a real hang class without adding config surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Calendar helper and its main callers are most directly tied to vincentkoc in current-main history.
